text:
amy_support: FYI — AcmeCorp escalation: rerank API returning 502/504 spikes and client-visible timeouts during load test. They reported p95 jumps from ~120ms to 3.5s and ~7% 5xx rate over a 10m window. Payload attached.
lee_engineer: Can you paste a repro payload and the exact timestamps? suspecting large candidate fanout + batching + KV cache miss pattern.
amy_support: Here is the gist of the request they sent (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"rerank-xl","query":"how to deploy","candidates": ["id1","id2", ..., "id20000"],"max_candidates":20000,"top_k":10,"client_batch":5}'
```
They said they batch 5 requests together and each request has 20k candidates (we asked them to reduce but they wanted to repro prod behavior).
nisha_oncall: I pulled gateway traces for route `POST /v1/rerank` 2419876480-2419876540 window: saw a lot of upstream 502s from the ranker pool and repeated retries. snippet: `ERROR upstream_request( ranker-v2 ): 502 Bad Gateway after 3 retries; latency 3500ms`
Also high connection_pool.wait_count and short socket timeouts hitting qps spikes.
deploybot: deploy v2.1.3 of rerank service was rolled at 2419876000 (no config changes to timeouts).
lee_engineer: quick hypothesis: KV cache thrash + large seq lengths -> backend tokenization + attention cost spikes, plus gateway retry loop amplifying load. Also client-side batching multiplies upstream concurrency.
marta_prod: Did customer use streaming or non-streaming? streaming avoids big memory blowups.
amy_support: non-streaming; they expect full-score array back in one response.
sam_sre: From infra metrics: host-level CPU and GC jump on ranker instances that handled those requests. connection_pool saturation observed (max_inflight reached). Also outbound retries from gateway increased cumulative QPS to ranker by ~2.4x due to retries.
lee_engineer: Short-term mitigations to propose: 1) Ask customer to lower `max_candidates` to <=2000 or paginate candidates; 2) Turn off client batching (send single request per flow) or limit client_batch to 1; 3) Gate at gateway: add circuit-breaker + fail-fast for candidate > 5k; 4) Route heavy calls to a lower-capacity model or offline rerank job.
I'll open a PR with a soft limit check and 429 fast-fail for >5k.
sam_sre: Also recommend bumping gateway upstream timeout to 10s and reduce retry attempts from 3 -> 1 for rerank route to avoid amplification.
nisha_oncall: Can we get a heap + thread dump from one of the ranker pods that logged the 502? also need the exact request-id from the customer for matching traces.
amy_support: Customer provided request-id X-Req-Id: rc-83f9e2. Sharing now and asking for a reduced repro bundle.
lee_engineer: Repro plan: 1) emulate their pattern with 5 concurrent clients each sending 20k candidates; 2) run against staging cluster with same model variant; 3) observe KV cache hit/miss, CPU, GC, and per-token latency tail. I'll instrument additional tracing for tokenization time.
marta_prod: For longer-term: we should add a max_candidates config per model and an advisory SDK warning when client tries to exceed it. Also add a throttling policy in routing layer for heavy fanout.
sam_sre: Action items: - @lee_engineer run repro on staging and paste results (ETA 2h) - @nisha_oncall collect heap+gc logs from affected pods and upload to ops ticket - @amy_support coordinate with customer about reduced-candidate repro and inform them to expect a 429 mitigation if we implement gating - @marta_prod create product ticket for model-level candidate caps
amy_support: I'll notify AcmeCorp and offer a temporary workaround (reduce candidates + disable batching). Will escalate contract SLA if they hit customer impact.
lee_engineer: noting potential quick fix rolling: soft 5k cap with telemetry opt-in so we don't break clients. I'll draft RFC.
amy_support: thanks team. keeping thread open until repro complete and mitigation deployed. :folded_hands:
